value.rationale: A natural complete class of possible output laws is characterized exactly, simultaneously solving every continuous convex Jensen-loss optimization with fixed mean and slope/endpoints. This goes beyond rephrasing a single existing inequality: it supplies the realization converse and surprising oscillation-irrelevance, a unique geometric extremizer classification, and sharp variance benchmark.
